evidence.title: Agility Robotics Expands Pittsburgh Presence to Support Growing Customer Deployments
evidence.excerpt: PITTSBURGH — Oct. 21, 2026 — Agility Robotics , a leading humanoid robotics and physical AI company, today announced plans to significantly expand its presence in Pittsburgh with a new 50,000-square-foot facility designed to support Agility’s expanding customer base and a growing number of commercial Digit® deployments. The new site will serve as Agility’s center of excellence for software and AI, with a focus on Digit skill development and software enablement, while also serving as a major hub for customer deployment and support teams. Agility’s investment in Pittsburgh comes amid growing customer momentum for Digit. Digit is already operating with leading global companies including GXO, Schaeffler, and Toyota Motor Manufacturing Canada. Agility is also expanding its customer base with four additional customers across industries including automotive, consumer goods and agriculture. Earlier this week Agility announced a new pilot with AGCO, a global leader in agricultural machinery and precision agriculture technologies.
